name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(target_picked_up) is not in the task; no sentence says the target box must be picked up. The task says to pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); with the hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) it also forces the target box to be picked up.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires picking up the target box, but the hard Existence(target_picked_up) clause does not imply that the agent will pick up the box; it only implies that target_picked_up will happen at least once, and the episode will end when it does. However, the hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) clause implies that has_door_key and door_open will both happen, which means the agent will have the key and will be able to open the door. To pick up the target box, the agent needs to have the key and the door needs to be open, so the task requires a ChainResponse(has_door_key, door_open) to ensure that has_door_key happens before door_open. Add the ChainResponse(has_door_key, door_open) clause.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to pick up the target box, but the hard Existence(target_picked_up) clause is not enough. The task also requires the agent to open the door before picking up the box, but the RespondedExistence clause does not capture this requirement. To fix this, add a hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) clause to ensure that the door is open before the target box is picked up. This will make the machine accept the task as it is intended.
